blueprint.name: NetBox
blueprint.description: Single-node NetBox instance on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS. Installs PostgreSQL, Redis, NetBox (via Git), Gunicorn, and nginx with a self-signed SSL certificate. All components are configured via an Ansible playbook.

instance.name: ${app.name}-netbox
instance.description: NetBox – network source of truth (PostgreSQL + Redis + Gunicorn + nginx)

options.name: netbox_version
options.label: NetBox Version
options.description: Git release tag to install (e.g. v4.3.4). See https://github.com/netbox-community/netbox/releases.

options.name: db_password
options.label: Database Password
options.description: Password for the netbox PostgreSQL user. Use a strong, random value.

options.name: allowed_hosts
options.label: Allowed Hosts
options.description: ALLOWED_HOSTS value for NetBox (hostname, IP, or * for any). Should match the server's DNS name or IP address.

options.name: admin_username
options.label: Admin Username
options.description: Username for the initial NetBox superuser account.

options.name: admin_password
options.label: Admin Password
options.description: Password for the initial NetBox superuser account.

options.name: admin_email
options.label: Admin Email
options.description: Email address for the initial NetBox superuser account.
